pr.title: Add CSV statement export
pr.body:
Adds `--format csv` to `ledger statement`, backed by a new `ledger/export.py` that reuses `statement_rows`.

Closes #3.

issues.title: Export statements as CSV
issues.body:
Statements are text-only today; accountants want to open them in a spreadsheet.

Acceptance:

1. `ledger statement FILE ACCOUNT --format csv` prints the statement as CSV; text stays the default.
2. The first row is the header `date,description,amount,balance`.
3. Amounts and balances use the text statement's decimal format, for example `-4.50`.
4. Descriptions containing commas, quotes, or newlines round-trip through Python's `csv.reader`.
